candidate_interval: two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for the unique-seed failure proportion
claim_rule: A streamed candidate may be described as having paired evidence of fewer failures than its lane's old g04 comparator only when the joint-all-gates endpoint is complete, old_fail_new_pass exceeds old_pass_new_fail, and the Holm-adjusted exact paired-discordance p-value is below 0.05. Zero observed failures alone is not evidence of superiority and is not called robust.
effective_unit: one of 512 shared input seeds; the two gate views and any identical output/grid views are not independent replicates
gate_specific_endpoints: descriptive diagnostics; no independent-sample tests and no gate-view sample-size inflation
multiplicity: Holm correction across the six preregistered joint-all-gates old-versus-streamed contrasts
paired_test: two-sided exact binomial McNemar/discordance test with p=0.5, computed on shared seeds
primary_endpoint: per seed, failure means a collection failure or failure of either frozen mixed gate
threshold_policy: all metrics are scored against the unchanged frozen fused-v2 mixed-gate thresholds; raw anchor_max*safety_factor exceedances and threshold-utilization ratios are descriptive only
